chapters.name: Gunna
chapters.text: Guns of the later Ages, made from gunmetal, gun hearts and iron nets. Sidearms and the scatter gun come first, rifles and the belt-fed gun in Age VII, long guns, rockets and energy weapons with Rodos.

items.name: daug bhieg
items.text: Light Sidearm: sidearm of Age VI. 5 hp a shot, 300 rounds a minute, one shot per pull, 15 in the magazine, effective to 40 m, uses 9 mm Round. Hold use to fire, R to reload, sneak + use with a fitting in the off hand to attach it.

items.name: daug throum
items.text: Heavy Sidearm: sidearm of Age VI. 6.5 hp a shot, 240 rounds a minute, one shot per pull, 8 in the magazine, effective to 40 m, uses .45 Round. Hold use to fire, R to reload, sneak + use with a fitting in the off hand to attach it.

items.name: daug mhòir
